title: A PDE Derivation of the Schrödinger--Bass Bridge
summary: This short paper announces the main results of \cite{SBB2026}, where the Schrödinger--Bass Bridge (SBB) problem is introduced and studied in full generality. Here we provide a direct PDE derivation of the SBB system in dimension one, showing how the optimal coupling problem that interpolates between the classical Schrödinger bridge and the Bass martingale transport can be solved explicitly via Legendre transforms and the heat equation.
